purpose: Define validation of tool input/output schema, capability claims, execution bounds and endpoint compatibility before registration or invocation.

owns: Tool Schema and Capability Validation semantics

topics.name: Tool Schema and Capability Validation
topics.purpose: Define validation of tool input/output schema, capability claims, execution bounds and endpoint compatibility before registration or invocation.

semantics.input_rule: Tool input schema is explicit and machine-validated.
semantics.output_rule: Output schema/profile is explicit where machine-significant.
semantics.bound_rule: Timeout, size, rate, concurrency or other execution bounds are explicit where needed.
semantics.compatibility_rule: Registered binding must remain compatible with exact validated endpoint capability version/profile.
semantics.unknown_rule: Unknown arguments/capabilities fail according to explicit extension policy.
semantics.validation_rule: Invocation rechecks applicable schema/capability constraints before dispatch.
semantics.authority_rule: Schema compatibility does not imply authorization.

invariants.rule: MCP endpoint identity, advertised capability, validated #T tool identity, concrete invocation and returned result are separate identities; advertisement or availability never grants execution authority.

prose.summary: Define validation of tool input/output schema, capability claims, execution bounds and endpoint compatibility before registration or invocation.
